title: Bidirectional Process Links (link/1, spawn_link/1) & Normal vs. Abnormal Exit Signals
solutionExplanation: Implements a two-stage linked pipeline demonstrating normal exit survival vs abnormal exit propagation.

otpDocCards.description: Atomically creates a new process and establishes a bidirectional link with caller.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: O(1) allocation and lock-free link registration.

otpDocCards.description: Creates a bidirectional link between caller and target Pid.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: O(1). If Pid is dead, sends {EXIT, Pid, noproc}.

mentalModelCheck.question: When process A and process B are linked, what happens to process B if process A terminates with `exit(normal)`?

options.label: Process B ignores the normal exit signal and continues executing undisturbed (unless it is explicitly trapping exits).
options.explanation: Correct! By definition, an exit signal with reason `normal` indicates clean task completion. Non-trapping linked peers ignore `normal` exit signals and stay alive.

options.label: Process B terminates immediately with reason normal.
options.explanation: Only abnormal exit reasons terminate non-trapping linked peers.

options.label: The BEAM scheduler pauses process B until a supervisor wakes it up.
options.explanation: Process B is not paused; it continues running without interruption.
